name: METRO
recent: METRO 近期出现董事与财务总监的股权变动，包括董事经理 Lim Wai Khong 增持及财务总监 Khoo Chiau Chi 先增持后减持。公司也公布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的业绩。
notable: 董事经理 Lim Wai Khong 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日增持 300,000 股普通股。
财务总监 Khoo Chiau Chi 于 2026 年 9 月 21 日增持 250,000 股，并于 2026 年 10 月 6 日减持 120,000 股。
Chong Khai Siang 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日出现董事会变动。
risks: 财务总监 Khoo Chiau Chi 于 2026 年 10 月 6 日减持 120,000 股。

recent_en: METRO recently saw changes in directors' and financial controller's shareholdings, including an acquisition by Managing Director Lim Wai Khong and both an acquisition and disposal by Financial Controller Khoo Chiau Chi. The company also announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Managing Director Lim Wai Khong acquired 300,000 ordinary shares on 29 September 2026.
Financial Controller Khoo Chiau Chi acquired 250,000 shares on 21 September 2026 and disposed of 120,000 shares on 6 October 2026.
There was a change in the boardroom regarding Chong Khai Siang on 14 September 2026.
risks_en: Financial Controller Khoo Chiau Chi disposed of 120,000 shares on 6 October 2026.
